note: PROVENANCE LEDGER for probabilities introduced by agent authoring, pending owner ratification. This is a REVIEW QUEUE, not a gate: no script reads it and no CI step fails on it. It is written so that every number an agent put into the corpus can be found, sourced and ratified in one pass, rather than being indistinguishable from a calibrated one six months later. `decided_by` is the point of the file and follows the convention of occurrence_reviewed.json: it never says 'reviewed', it says WHO. `agent-draft` carries no more weight than the reasoning printed beside it. Ratify by setting decided_by to `owner_decision` (optionally adjusting the value first); delete a row once its value has been through the calibration pipeline and the value is no longer a draft. Attempt probability (occurrence%) has NO automated seeding path in this repo by design — calibrate_probabilities.py routes occurrence% and outcome_dist to a human-gated proposal file because, unlike success%, they have no self-correcting community-vote loop. Every attempt row below is therefore a seed awaiting elicitation, not an estimate.

schema.basis: where the number came from — an existing corpus number, a threshold, or (flagged) a judgement
schema.invented: true when no corpus number anchors it; these are the rows to calibrate first

Each frame must sum to 100, so the new entry's mass is absorbed by rescaling every pre-existing entry PROPORTIONALLY through scripts/_prob_norm.largest_remainder_round — the repo's single normalizer, which preserves each move's relative share exactly and puts the leftover units on the largest fractional parts.
